subject: SOC 2 renewal: artifact sprint + retention carveout for seat addition
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: lumina-security@luminahealth.com, Lavanya Rao <l.rao@luminahealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 renewal: artifact sprint + retention carveout for seat addition

Hi Lavanya / Lumina security team,

Thanks again for the heads-up about the renewal window. Per our conversation last week, Lumina is planning a SOC 2 re-attestation tied to the upcoming renewal, and I wanted to propose a short "artifact sprint" to get your auditors the exact snapshots they asked for while minimizing disruption to your production environment.

High-level proposal:
- 72-hour artifact sprint window where we provide compressed evidence bundles (API request traces, auth logs, policy change history) scoped to the requested timeframe.
- Temporary retention carveout: retain the sprint artifacts for 90 days in an ephemeral staging bucket (customer-controlled access).
- Temporary seat addition: enable +50 concurrent seats for the renewal testing window; billing prorated for the quarter.

Attachments: I have an initial evidence matrix and a short upload how-to (see attached stub filenames).

Questions for you:
1) Do your auditors require raw streaming logs or are compressed daily snapshots acceptable?
2) Confirm the exact audit window (start/end dates) and which environments (prod, staging) we should include.
3) Any contractual guardrails your legal team needs for the temporary retention carveout?

If that works, I suggest a 45-minute technical walkthrough next week to align on formats and delivery. I can loop in our engineering lead (Marcus) and legal/sales (Kimberly) to finalize.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), artifact-upload-instructions.md (text stub)

From: Joaquin Perez <j.perez@luminahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Lavanya Rao <l.rao@luminahealth.com>
Cc: lumina-security@luminahealth.com
Date: 2027-07-01T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: artifact sprint + retention carveout for seat addition

Alex —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A couple of quick clarifications before we lock dates:

- Snapshot vs streaming: Our auditors prefer raw logs where possible, but they will accept compressed snapshots if they contain unaltered request/response IDs and timestamps. Can you include a verification manifest (hashes) in the bundles?
- Scope: We need the 2027-05-01 to 2027-05-31 window for prod only; staging is optional.
- Retention carveout: legal will want explicit start/end dates and a deletion certification. Who from Redwood signs off on that?
- Seat addition: +50 is fine for the test; please confirm whether the throughput guarantee changes during the sprint and if there is an escalation contact if we see sustained degradation.

I've attached our auditor intake form (stub: lumina_auditor_request.pdf) and copied our security lead Lavanya.

Can we do the technical walkthrough on Tue 2027-07-06 at 10:00 AM PT? Please confirm Marcus and Kimberly's availability.

Thanks,
Joaquin Perez
Security Program Manager | Lumina Health
j.perez@luminahealth.com

Attachments: lumina_auditor_request.pdf (external stub)

- They will accept compressed snapshots if we include integrity manifests (hashes).
- Request: temporary 90-day staging retention and +50 seats during the test.

If we can respond by EOD today, I'll send Lumina a firm plan and the attachments (evidence matrix + upload instructions + carveout draft).

Alex

Joaquin / Lavanya —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the auditor intake form. Confirming next steps:

Plan we can deliver:
- Artifacts: We will produce compressed daily bundles for the requested window (2027-05-01 -> 2027-05-31) containing auth logs, API traces (request/response IDs preserved), policy-change records, and a SHA256 manifest file per bundle for integrity verification.
- Delivery: Redwood will provision an ephemeral, customer-controlled staging bucket and upload the bundles within 72 hours of the kickoff. Retention carveout: bundles retained for 90 days post-upload; Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate at the end of the carveout.
- Throughput & seats: We will enable +50 concurrent seats for the sprint. Marcus confirmed no change to baseline SLAs for short-lived bursts; if we observe sustained degradation we will escalate to our on-call infra lead (Marcus, cc'd).
- Legal: Kimberly will share a short carveout appendix (start/end dates + deletion cert language + limited liability wording) before EOD today.

Attachments included: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx, retention_carveout_proposal.pdf, artifact-upload-instructions.md

Proposed walkthrough: Tue 2027-07-06, 10:00 AM PT — please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite and a Zoom link.

If this aligns, we'll treat the sprint as an orderable add-on under DL-7843 with prorated pricing; Kimberly will include the billing stub in the appendix.

Appreciate the partnership — we'll move quickly to get auditors everything they need without expanding your production blast radius.

Best,
